title: Error Handling Stack
description: Layered error feedback pattern: page-level validation summary, contextual alert, highlighted callout, and field-level error state.

components.reason: Page-level error summary; the focus target when submission fails
Contextual error message for a section of the page
Highlighted callout for critical information the user must not miss
Field-level error pattern: instantiate the errored input with aria-invalid and a linked error message

nesting: Use the highest layer that fits: component 1 at the top of the form/page; component 2 within the failing section; component 3 for critical one-off callouts; component 4 is the field-level pattern applied inside the form (requires form wrapper prerequisite)
validationOrder: Every error message is linked to its control via aria-describedby
Error summary items anchor to the offending input ids
Only one page-level error summary per view
a11yNotes: Move focus to the validation summary on failed submission
Do not rely on color alone — each error carries text
role='alert' on dynamically rendered errors only, not on static page load
Keep error text actionable: state what is wrong and how to fix it
agentPromptSequence: 1. Fetch the validation alert (order 1) and place it above the form
2. Apply the field-level error pattern (order 4) to each failing input inside the form wrapper
3. Add the section-level error alert (order 2) only when a whole section fails
4. Reserve the summary-box (order 3) for critical non-form callouts
5. Verify every error is linked to its control before finishing
